slides.title: Light Requirements
bullets: Boston ferns like bright, indirect light.
Direct sun burns the fronds.

slides.title: Watering Instructions
bullets: Keep the soil moist but not wet.
Mist the leaves twice a week in winter.

slides.title: Feeding Schedule
bullets: Feed once a month from April to September.

slides.title: Moss Garden Requirements
bullets: A moss garden needs shade, acid soil and steady moisture.

slides.title: Site Selection
bullets: Pick a spot with at least 4 hours of shade.

slides.title: Soil Requirements
bullets: Soil pH should be between 5.0 and 5.5.

slides.title: Planting
bullets: Press moss pieces firmly into bare soil.

slides.title: Initial Watering
bullets: Water every day for the first three weeks.

slides.title: Maintenance (Autumn)
bullets: Remove fallen leaves each week in autumn.

slides.title: Title Slide
bullets: Information about a pond

slides.title: Size
bullets: A pond of 2 by 3 metres suits most gardens.

slides.title: Sloping End
bullets: One end should slope gently so animals can climb out.

slides.title: Lining
bullets: Use a 0.5 mm rubber liner on a layer of sand.

slides.title: Plants (Oxygenating)
bullets: Add oxygenating plants such as hornwort.

slides.title: Lily Pads
bullets: Cover no more than half the surface with lily pads.

slides.title: Timing
bullets: Dig in early spring and fill with rainwater.
